result.title: Factorized MLLM Embeddings for Composed Image Retrieval
result.summary: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a target image given a reference image and a modification text. Although recent approaches leveraging Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown significant progress, we argue that the MLLM's compositional understanding remains underutilized. This stems from directly mapping composed queries into a retrieval embedding via contrastive supervision alone, without explicitly resolving the intended visual modifications. In this work, we introduce Factorized MLLM Embeddings (FactEmbed), which decouples compositional query comprehension from building discriminative embeddings. Rather than directly projecting the composed query into a single embedding without internal reasoning, FactEmbed employs a set of factorized latents that simulate the intended visual modifications via an intermediate target imagination objective. This process encourages the latents to ground into target semantics before forming discriminative representations for retrieval. Subsequently, to propagate these factorized representations throughout the model for retrieval, we optimize a factor-level contrastive loss while distilling the decomposed representations into a deeper attention layer of the MLLM. Finally, for efficient inference, we retain the [EOS] token to establish a global-level embedding on top of these factorized latents, while we exploit the mean-pooled factorized latents to rerank a short candidate list at negligible cost, as both are produced by the same forward pass. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that FactEmbed outperforms prior works across CIR benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文面向组合图像检索（CIR），提出 FactEmbed，将组合查询理解与判别嵌入构建解耦：用一组分解 latent 经「目标想象」中间目标模拟预期视觉修改，配合 factor 级对比损失并蒸馏到更深注意力层，推理时以 [EOS] 全局嵌入检索、用 latent 均值池化重排候选。
AI.relevance_reason: 分解 latent 被中间目标显式约束以先承载修改后的目标语义，可供核查 latent 是否真正编码视觉细节与修改内容、监督如何分配到各因子、层蒸馏与池化对表示的影响；但任务是静态检索嵌入，不涉及逐步推理、证据获取或停止决策。
